summary: Jin Medical International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, reporting its entry into a VIE Control Acquisition and Share Issuance Agreement with its WFOE, Beijing Tongsheng Technology Co., Ltd. (Target), and Chang Gil Lee (Seller). The Company will issue Class A Ordinary Shares valued at US$105,329,974 as consideration, with the per-share price determined by the lowest 90-day VWAP prior to execution. The acquisition grants contractual control over the Target via VIE agreements, which include economic benefit rights, equity pledge, voting proxy, and exclusive option rights. No legal title to Target's equity is obtained. The transaction requires shareholder approval at an EGM and Class A/B meetings. No advisor or board recommendation explicitly stated. Watch for shareholder vote outcome; risk-arb focus on approval and VIE structure enforceability.
